fix(startup): serve settlement before World readiness with gated capabilities

The gRPC listener waited for the supervised World startup barrier before it
served, while the World replay bootstrap needs the Auth/Friend invalidation
sources whose own startup verifies owner-authority settlement against this same
endpoint. Neither side could finish, so the dev stack stopped with "Owner
authority unavailable" and "World replay bootstrap unavailable".

The listener now binds immediately behind a deny-by-default gate. Only
authority.lease.v1.ProducerSettlementService answers while the gate is closed;
every other mounted capability returns UNAVAILABLE "World not ready": the
ConcertService bootstrap, WorldService, both participant services, the product,
delivery and archive services, the feed-callback root read, the notification
target authority and the deferred account-deletion slot. A concurrent component
awaits the World barrier and flips the gate; a dropped barrier requests shared
shutdown and preserves the original error. serve_with_shutdown is unchanged.

The closure driver now projects its receipt through the driver's own prepared
command instead of the inner lifecycle service, which bypassed the ephemeral
fence permission that START requires. The shared projection keeps the exact
closed receipt statuses for the close route.

Cargo: tower.workspace (already a workspace dependency and a dev-dependency;
the layer needs the real Layer/Service traits, so no new crate or lock change).

Tests: the allowlist is exactly the settlement service; a closed gate answers
settlement and refuses every gated service without reaching the owner; opening
the gate after readiness serves them; a dropped World barrier requests shutdown
with the original error and never opens the gate. All 9 binary tests pass.
